basic_details.job_title: ESIC Medical College Kolkata Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 - Walkin for 85 Posts
basic_details.post_name: Senior Resident under Residency Scheme (Clinical, Non-Clinical, and Super Specialties)

application_fee.details: Mode of Payment: A Demand Draft for Rs. 500/- (as applicable) in favour of ‘ESI Fund Account No. 1’ drawn on any scheduled bank payable at Kolkata has to be submitted along with the application form at the time of document verification cum walk-in interview. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

age_limit.details: The upper age-limit for appointment as a Senior Resident in broad specialties shall be forty-five (45) years: Provided that for the subjects of Anatomy, Biochemistry, and Physiology, the upper age-limit shall be fifty (50) years as on the date of interview. Age relaxation is applicable as per Central Government rules in force.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | senior resident under residency scheme (clinical/non-clinical departments): Medical PG Degree (MD/MS/DNB) in concerned specialty from MCI/NMC recognized Medical Institution/Hospital; OR Postgraduate medical degree in Master of Science with Doctor of Philosophy in the subjects of Medical Anatomy or Medical Biochemistry or Medical Physiology. Candidates must be registered under MCI/NMC/State Medical Council. Candidates on bond are not eligible. Candidates need to provide Bond clearance certificate from Appointing Authority who has completed compulsory post PG Bond Service. | senior resident under residency scheme for super specialties: DM/MCh/DNB in the concerned subject; OR MD/MS/DNB qualified graduates in the concerned broad specialty.

salary_details.details: In addition to the above cited consolidated remuneration, Senior Residents under the Residency Scheme (Clinical and Non-clinical) will be entitled to transport allowance and DA on transport allowance as per relevant rules from time to time. In the case of non-medical candidates, the Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) will be deducted from the above-mentioned consolidated remuneration.

how_to_apply: Verify your eligibility based on the official notification requirements and age limits.
Download the application form format (Annexure I) and verification slip (Annexure II) from the official notification PDF.
Fill out the application form neatly typed in the prescribed format with double spacing on A4 size paper.
Prepare the required application fee via Demand Draft of Rs. 500/- in favour of ‘ESI Fund Account No. 1’ payable at Kolkata (if applicable).
Gather all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies and two recent passport-size photographs.

Report for document verification between 09:30 AM and 10:30 AM on the scheduled interview date (03.11.2026 for Non-Clinical or 04.11.2026 for Clinical & Super Specialties) at the Academic Block 2nd Floor of ESI-PGIMSR & ESIC Medical College, Joka.
Attend the walk-in interview following successful document verification.
important_instructions: The engagement is initially for a period of one year, extendable up to a total period of three years subject to satisfactory performance. Private practice of any kind is not allowed. Selected candidates must execute a contract on a stamp paper of Rs. 100/-. On engagement, Senior Residents are required to deposit a security of Rs. 32,000/- through Demand Draft in favour of ESI Fund Account No. 1 at the time of joining. Residential accommodation/quarter will be provided subject to availability; if provided, House Rent Allowance (HRA) will not be allowed. Candidates must attend emergency duties as well as round-the-clock floor duties in shifts as assigned. If the turnout of candidates is more than the ratio of 1:10 per post, a screening test with multiple-choice questions may be conducted at the discretion of the competent authority. Candidates reporting beyond 10:30 AM for document verification shall not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. What is ESIC Medical College Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a walk-in recruitment drive conducted by ESI-PGIMSR, ESIC Medical College & Hospital and ODC (EZ) Joka, Kolkata to engage Senior Residents (3 years tenure) under the residency scheme on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ESIC Kolkata Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 85 vacancies are available, comprising 17 vacancies for non-clinical departments and 68 vacancies for clinical and super specialty departments.

faq.question: Q3. What are the walk-in interview dates?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled for 03.11.2026 for Non-Clinical departments and 04.11.2026 for Clinical departments and Super Specialties.

faq.question: Q4. What is the reporting time for document verification?
faq.answer: Candidates must report between 09:30 AM and 10:30 AM at the Academic Block 2nd Floor of ESI-PGIMSR & ESIC Medical College, Joka. Candidates reporting beyond 10:30 AM will not be considered.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years for broad specialties, except for Anatomy, Biochemistry, and Physiology, where the upper age limit is 50 years as on the date of interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Medical PG Degree (MD/MS/DNB) in the concerned specialty from an MCI/NMC recognized institution, or a postgraduate medical degree in Master of Science with a PhD in Medical Anatomy, Biochemistry, or Physiology, along with valid medical council registration.

faq.question: Q7. What is the consolidated salary for Senior Residents?
faq.answer: The selected Senior Residents will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 1,50,294/- per month along with applicable transport allowances.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for all other categories, while SC, ST, PWD, Women candidates, and Ex-servicemen are exempted (NIL fee). The fee must be paid via Demand Draft in favour of 'ESI Fund Account No. 1' payable at Kolkata.
